notes: The 1cs suffix of `אֲדֹנָי` is lexicalized in the title and the ASV writes no possessive, so it is `unrepresented` beside `אֲדֹנָ` → *the Lord* (rule 57); the reversed order of the two divine names here does not change that reading.
`לְרֹאשִׁי` is recast as the bare object *my head*, leaving the preposition no English word (rule 40).
